about: I’m a software engineer early in my career, passionate about developing systems that prioritize maintainability and scalability, building robust foundations for future growth.

Beyond technical implementation, my favorite work lies at the intersection of design and development. I’m energized by the challenge of translating complex, evolving requirements into elegant, high-performing features that users genuinely enjoy.
I thrive in dynamic environments where I can continuously grow, solve complex problems, and build software that stands the test of time.
Outside of work, I enjoy investing, playing chess, and constantly seeking opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

experience.description: Managed and optimized databases to enhance application performance. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, designers, and product managers, to implement and advocate for best practices in web accessibility.

Gained foundational IT knowledge and skills, fueling my passion for technology. Collaborated on various IT projects with teams and established valuable industry connections, which led to internship opportunities.
